data.engagement_subtitle: Three ways to work with us — pick the model that fits your stage and budget.

engagement_models.name: Project-Based
engagement_models.description: A fixed scope, timeline, and price. You tell us what you need — we deliver it. No surprises.
engagement_models.features:
Fixed scope & price
Milestone-based delivery
Detailed project roadmap
Dedicated project manager

engagement_models.name: Monthly Retainer
engagement_models.description: Ongoing development hours with priority access. Your dedicated team, always available — for products that keep evolving.
engagement_models.features:
Guaranteed monthly hours
Priority support & fast turnaround
Continuous iteration & improvement
Flexible scope adjustments

Engineers embedded in your workflow
Full-time or part-time availability

Rapid onboarding
